role: Derived appearance assets for the original Anatome specimen
anatomy: Anatomical geometry is sourced separately from BodyParts3D and the Mauritanian Anatomy Laboratory thoracic atlas. Specimen materials do not displace anatomy.
method: Organ and chest-wall exteriors and cut faces use separate object-space colour, smoothness and relief maps. Chest-wall maps depict a thin-skin surface, cut dermal connective tissue, adipose lobules, a collagen sheet and skeletal muscle fascicles. Pigmentation, strand directions and cut texture are authored gross appearance cues. Source references and limits are in docs/SUPERFICIAL-TISSUE-APPEARANCE.md.
reconstruction: FMA7163 skin has an authored wall; REC_fat and REC_fascia remain authored envelope-based teaching layers. Their measured thickness and exact microstructure are not claimed.
bone: The existing bone-cap shader and distance-derived cortical/cancellous teaching contrast are retained.
preservation: Materials and PNGs are stored separately under Resources/Learning/Specimen. Original source maps, meshes, LODs and geometry provenance remain unchanged.
